strategy.thesis: Japan's central government funding agency for medical R&D (Japan's 'NIH equivalent'), unifying budgets formerly split across MEXT/MHLW/METI. lifesci.science_platform_notes: Manages Tokyo University of Science's 2nd venture fund (2019, JPY 7.5B); TUS established its 1st fund in 2016 and 2nd fund in 2019.

summary.en: TUSIC is Tokyo University of Science's venture-capital arm (est. Nov 2018) managing the JPY 7.5B TUSIC 2nd fund and investing in life science among other deep-tech fields.

summary.en: HIC is Hiroshima University's launched VC (Hiroshima Prefecture's first university-originated VC); its first fund (~JPY 1.2B, formed Jan 2026) backs university spinouts including medical/bio ventures.
